newsitem.title: MEXICO: Helicopter crashes over Mexican drug-running zone.
newsitem.headline: Helicopter crashes over Mexican drug-running zone.

text.p: A police helicopter flying over a wild mountainous drug-running area of Mexico crashed late on Monday, injuring all 14 people on board, media reports said on Tuesday.
The Bell-212 helicopter, belonging to the Attorney General's Office for anti-drugs operations, came down south of the southern city of Oaxaca, 240 miles (400 km) east of Mexico City, reports said.

No deaths were reported, although the three crew members and 11 drug agents were taken to a hospital in Oaxaca suffering serious injuries, Radio Red reported. Two of the injured were later flown to Mexico City for surgery.
Officials told Radio Red that a mechnical fault caused the helicopter to lose altitude suddenly, crashing close to a distant reservoir near the village of San Baltazar.
State-owned news agency Notimex said the agents were on an operation to destroy drug plantations.
